en.headline: sogeisetsu: 25 commits across 3 repos, 1 issue comment, no releases
en.summary: On 2026-10-22, `sogeisetsu` made **25 own commits** spread across three repositories, plus 30 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` the work was 13 own commits: probing and documenting `deepseek` `reasoning_effort` behavior (including that `none` disables thinking), switching the `minimax` free leg to `reasoning_effort=low` because `none` returns a 400, adding then removing temporary probe workflows, and repointing the codemap baseline to `d93ea4d`. In `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` there were 9 commits: an MV3 skeleton, bilingual page rendering with chunk splitting, a circuit breaker and progress reporting, a provider protocol layer with presets, model lists and a glossary pipeline, DOM smoke tests, page-state resets and required-field validation, `checkJs` typing via JSDoc, and an `AGENTS.md` constraints file; selection translation was dropped in favor of page translation only. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` there were 3 documentation commits covering the OMO slim bundled skill table, three new behavior-constraint skills in OMO slim v3.0.5, and a new `openchamber-storage` category. On issues, `sogeisetsu` commented on `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` issue #8 "[ai-failure] AI 叙述生成失败", which carries 5 comments.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu 当日 3 个仓库 25 次提交，评论 1 个 issue，无发布
zh.summary: 2026-10-22，`sogeisetsu` 共做出 **25 次本人提交**，分布在三个仓库中，另有 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中由 `github-actions[bot]` 完成的 30 次自动提交。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 有 13 次本人提交：实测并记录 `deepseek` 的 `reasoning_effort` 行为（其中 `none` 确实关闭思考），把 `minimax` 免费腿改为发送 `reasoning_effort=low`（`none` 会返回 400），先后新增又删除临时探针 workflow，并把 codemap 基线改指向 `d93ea4d`。在 `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 有 9 次提交：MV3 骨架、带分块拆分的双语页面渲染、熔断与进度、包含预设、模型列表和术语表管线的 provider 协议层、DOM 冒烟测试、页面状态重置与必填字段校验、基于 JSDoc 的 `checkJs` 类型检查，以及记录仓库约束与验证步骤的 `AGENTS.md`；同时移除了划词翻译，仅保留整页翻译。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 有 3 次文档提交，分别补充 OMO slim 随包 skill 全表、OMO slim v3.0.5 新增的三个行为约束型 skill，以及新增的 `openchamber-storage` 类别。issue 方面，`sogeisetsu` 在自己仓库的 #8「[ai-failure] AI 叙述生成失败」下发表评论，该 issue 共有 5 条评论。当日没有 pull request、评审、发布、star 或讨论记录；另有一条外部 issue `openchamber/openchamber` #5293（项目操作菜单中 Auto-discover dev server 会运行第一个已保存操作）由 `btriapitsyn` 关闭。
